usage: The word 床頭 refers to the head end of the bed where the headboard is located.
It is used as a noun to describe a specific part of the bed.
In sentences, 床頭 often acts as the subject or object relating to the bed furniture.
You can use 床頭 to describe location or position, for example, placing something near the headboard.
It is commonly combined with verbs that involve placing, attaching, or decorating around the bed.
